workspace_surface: The robot base and object operation area share the same wooden-board top surface.

operator_observation.description: The wooden board is straight and the gap can be approximated as zero.

configured_bound.reason_not_zero: The field is used as a collision inflation bound; an unquantified approximately-zero observation does not justify a strict zero bound.

formal_follow_up: Measure at least nine workspace points or use a verified straightedge and feeler gauges, then include instrument uncertainty.
